Russia’s Sberbank Sets December Deadline for Crypto Buildout: Report

Russia’s largest bank, Sberbank, will build crypto infrastructure by December, according to a report by Russian news agency Interfax.  A key piece will be a digital depository that tracks clients’ crypto rights and records off-blockchain transactions, while also handling wallet transfers to execute client orders, Interfax reported Monday.  Sberbank this month revealed plans to debut […]

This post Russia’s Sberbank Sets December Deadline for Crypto Buildout: Report first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo.
